key_insight: HISPO improves reinforcement-learning credit assignment for long math solutions by using entropy-derived segments as an intermediate granularity between token-level and sequence-level updates.
engineering_relevance: For large language model training, segment-level importance sampling offers a practical way to stabilize optimization and better target where reasoning quality is gained or lost in long completions.
method: Build contiguous response segments from rollout-time entropy signals
Assign soft saliency weights to segments based on entropy
Apply clipped importance-sampling policy optimization at the segment level
evidence_signal: Fine-tuning Qwen3-1.7B-Base on six math benchmarks, HISPO outperformed the strongest baseline in Pass@8 on all benchmarks and in Acc@8 on five, including AIME25 gains of +3.75 Acc@8 and +3.78 Pass@8 over GRPO.
watch_item: Segment construction depends on entropy quality and segmentation heuristics, so results may be sensitive to implementation details and may not transfer equally to other model sizes or reward settings.
paper_title: HISPO: Hierarchical Importance-Sampling Policy Optimization with Entropy-Derived Segments
